description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeePersonalDetailAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating an employee's personal details within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for fetching specific employee data, validating input parameters, and updating employee information such as name, ID, driving license, gender, and other personal details.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for fetching and updating employee personal details, manages request validation, and interfaces with employee service and configuration traits to perform operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific employee's personal details based on employee number.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the personal details of a specific employee, including validation and conditional fields based on configuration settings.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, indicating deletion functionality is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET request fetching employee details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating employee personal details, including conditional validation based on configuration.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception, indicating delete validation rules are not defined.
